chapter: Armstrong, Parker and life inside the Basie band
title: John Hammond's role with the Basie band
summary: Tate says Hammond practically ran the band's early career and got it exposure on Camel Caravan.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: What was the connection between the band and Hammond?

And John? Well, really, I think John owned the band at one time. I think, like when I first came in, because whatever he said, that's what happened, you know. And when -- because he like found the band and he did a lot for them.
Was he respected by the musicians?

Yeah. Yeah, they dug him. Everybody dug him. And he would get good spots for you. Now, he had -- he got Herschel and -- during the time when Benny had Basie, I mean, like John would put him places where they could be exposed, like on Camel Caravan. He would have guests, Lester, Buck, you know, somewhere where you can get some nice exposure, you know, places like that, have Basie all the time. And he would always say nice things about the band. Then he started trying to get him in places where Benny would play and Benny would always, you know, like try to get him where he could follow Benny and places like that. Once people heard the band, they really dug it, you know, they forgot about it a lot of times, they'd forget about those things, you know.
So John, he did a lot, he really did a lot for the band.
